title: We Will Stop Using Oil - Here's Why (EROI)
sources: Hall, Lambert & Balogh (2014), 'EROI of different fuels and the implications for society', Energy Policy - US oil EROI ~100:1 around 1930

Delannoy, Longaretti, Murphy & Prados (2021), 'Peak oil and the low-carbon energy transition: A net-energy perspective', Applied Energy 304 - liquids EROI ~6.7:1 today (about 15% of output reinvested), projected ~2:1 by 2050 (about half)
ITER / fusion timeline reporting (fusion research since the 1950s)
IEA, 'The Role of Critical Minerals in Clean Energy Transitions' (2021) - mining and shipping energy inputs

lines.text: Pro-oil people say we'll never run out of oil.
lines.caps: Pro-oil people say | we'll never run out of oil.

lines.text: And they're right.
lines.caps: And they're right.

lines.text: Just not the way they think.
lines.caps: Just not the way | they think.

lines.text: We'll be forced to stop using oil because of one term: EROI.
lines.caps: We'll be forced | to stop using oil | because of one term: | EROI.

lines.text: Energy Return on Investment.
lines.caps: Energy Return | on Investment.

lines.text: Pumping oil burns energy.
lines.caps: Pumping oil | burns energy.

lines.text: Drills, pumps, trucks, ships.
lines.caps: Drills, pumps, | trucks, ships.

lines.text: In 1930, America used about one barrel's worth of energy to get a hundred barrels out.
lines.caps: In 1930, | America used about | one barrel's worth of energy | to get a hundred | barrels out.

lines.text: Today, one study in the journal Applied Energy estimates it takes about fifteen.
lines.caps: Today, | one study in the journal | Applied Energy | estimates it takes | about fifteen.

lines.text: By 2050, it projects fifty.
lines.caps: By 2050, | it projects fifty.

lines.text: Half the oil, just to get the oil.
lines.caps: Half the oil, | just to get the oil.

lines.text: And you don't need to read the studies.
lines.caps: And you don't need | to read the studies.

lines.text: Just look around.
lines.caps: Just look around.

lines.text: In the early 1900s, almost all our oil came from easy wells on land.
lines.caps: In the early 1900s, | almost all our oil | came from easy wells | on land.

lines.text: Now we build massive rigs out at sea and crack rock apart to get it.
lines.caps: Now we build | massive rigs out at sea | and crack rock apart | to get it.

lines.text: Nobody does that for oil that's easy to reach.
lines.caps: Nobody does that | for oil that's | easy to reach.

lines.text: So what happens when it takes one barrel of oil to get one barrel back?
lines.caps: So what happens | when it takes | one barrel of oil | to get one barrel back?

lines.text: We stop.
lines.caps: We stop.

lines.text: The oil's still down there.
lines.caps: The oil's still | down there.

lines.text: There's just no reason to pump it.
lines.caps: There's just | no reason to pump it.

lines.text: The big hope is fusion.
lines.caps: The big hope | is fusion.

lines.text: But fusion has been "a few decades away" for over seventy years.
lines.caps: But fusion has been | "a few decades away" | for over seventy years.

lines.text: And green tech can't build more green tech, not yet.
lines.caps: And green tech | can't build | more green tech, | not yet.

lines.text: Solar panels still need diesel to dig up the metal, ships burning oil to carry it, and trucks to bring it to you.
lines.caps: Solar panels | still need diesel | to dig up the metal, | ships burning oil | to carry it, | and trucks | to bring it to you.

lines.text: So the key is to see how much abundance we still have.
lines.caps: So the key is | to see how much abundance | we still have.

lines.text: Slow down.
lines.caps: Slow down.

lines.text: Get some solar panels.
lines.caps: Get some | solar panels.

lines.text: Learn real skills.
lines.caps: Learn real skills.

lines.text: Get involved in your community.
lines.caps: Get involved | in your community.

lines.text: If you're prepared, the decline can lead to a better way of life.
lines.caps: If you're prepared, | the decline can lead | to a better way of life.
